sources.title: OpenStreetMap Nominatim search API

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Overpass API public instances
supports: OSM roads, tracks, paths, power features, buildings, natural features, waterways, and barriers for the Sunol offline upload bundle
limits: Public instances can rate-limit, throttle, or block poorly identified clients.
OSM data is community maintained and not authoritative terrain, utility, or safety truth.
Use a clear custom user agent, modest query counts, and mirror fallback.
sources.notes: Goal 0001 generator queries the main public endpoint first, then a mirror, and records selected endpoint plus source-health attempts in the manifest.

supports: 500m reduced elevation sample grid for the Sunol offline upload bundle

sources.title: USGS Geographic Names Information System (GNIS)

sources.title: National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP)
supports: high-resolution aerial basemap context for vegetation and structures visually
limits: Does not provide selectable forest polygons without classification.

sources.notes: Complements vector layers; optional Cesium ImageryProvider once a tile endpoint is chosen.

sources.title: National Land Cover Database (NLCD) via MRLC / USGS
